value.name: Marcus presents historical logbook
value.description: Marcus places a large logbook on the desk and identifies it as covering the years 1910 to 1940, offering Elena potentially useful material.
evidence: Marcus sets a large BLACK LOGBOOK on the desk between them.

MARCUS
This covers 1910 to 1940. Most of what you would find useful is in here.

value.name: Elena reviews and notes logbook
value.description: Elena begins paging through the logbook and taking notes on her legal pad, showing she is actively researching.
evidence: Elena pages through it, making notes on her yellow legal pad.

value.name: Elena raises Marcus's local reputation
value.description: Elena tells Marcus that townspeople mentioned him and said he had been at the lighthouse for as long as anyone could remember.
evidence:
ELENA
People in town mentioned you. One said you'd been out here as long as anyone could remember.

value.name: Marcus confirms decades-long tenure
value.description: Marcus tacitly confirms Elena's estimate that he has been there around thirty years, reinforcing his long-standing connection to the lighthouse.

value.name: Elena takes work call from Diane
value.description: Elena answers a buzzing phone and tells Diane she is still with Marcus and will deliver a draft by Friday.
evidence: Elena's phone buzzes. She steps back slightly and answers it.

ELENA
(into phone)
Diane, yes. I'm still with him. I'll have the draft by Friday, I promise.

value.name: Marcus moves to window after call
value.description: After Elena ends the call, Marcus has repositioned himself at the window, subtly withdrawing from the desk conversation.
evidence: She hangs up. Marcus has moved to the window.

value.name: Elena offers Marcus coffee
value.description: Elena pours from her thermos and offers Marcus a cup of coffee.
evidence: Elena offers him a cup of coffee poured from a thermos.

value.name: Marcus refuses hot drinks
value.description: Marcus firmly declines the coffee and reveals that he has never taken to hot drinks.
evidence:
MARCUS
(firm shake of his head)
No. I've never taken to hot drinks. Never have. You go ahead.

value.name: Elena studies Marcus while drinking
value.description: Elena pours herself coffee and watches Marcus closely, signaling continued scrutiny of him.
evidence: She pours a cup and studies him over the rim.
